projects.title: Hunting Goals — AI-Powered Winning Product Finder
bullets: Built a full-stack SaaS platform that scrapes real-time market signals (Facebook/Instagram Ads, Daraz, OLX, Google Trends, TikTok) to help Pakistani e-commerce sellers identify winning products ahead of competitors.
Designed a weighted AI 'Win Score' engine and integrated Groq AI to generate product analysis, ready-to-use ad copy, and supplier/sourcing recommendations.
Automated ad and market data collection with Puppeteer (stealth scraping) and delivered live in-app updates via Socket.io.
Implemented JWT authentication, Google OAuth, and Stripe subscription billing (Free/Pro/Business tiers) with webhook-driven plan management.
Built a responsive front end with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, and deployed the full system on Render with automated cron jobs and email/WhatsApp alerts.

projects.title: SEO Operator System — AI-Powered SEO Operating System
bullets: Built a full-stack SEO automation platform powered by 5 AI agents (technical audit, keyword research, content review, competitor gap analysis, action-plan synthesis) using the Groq API.
Integrated the official Google Search Console API via OAuth2 for rank tracking, encrypting refresh tokens at rest with AES-256-CBC.
Implemented Stripe subscription billing (Checkout, signature-verified webhooks, plan lifecycle) with server-enforced free-tier limits.
Designed an async job pipeline (queued → running → done/failed) with a cron-based watchdog for reliable long-running audits and reports.

Developed a React, TypeScript, and Vite front end with Tailwind CSS, Zustand state management, and Recharts data visualization; covered by 51 automated tests (Jest, Vitest) with CI via GitHub Actions.

projects.title: MindMate — Mental Health Support Platform
bullets: Developed a hybrid mental health platform combining an AI chatbot with real human doctor connectivity for immediate and ongoing support.
Fine-tuned a Llama 2 model across 30+ categories with 240+ curated responses to power instant AI-driven mental health support.
Enabled appointment booking, doctor messaging, and digital prescriptions within a secure MERN application.
Implemented JWT authentication, Google OAuth, and real-time messaging with Socket.io for secure, live patient-doctor communication.
